title: GET /users, GET /sites/{id}/users – 200 response
description: GET /users: the users who share a site with the caller, and the caller; ?site_id= limits them to one site. GET /sites/{id}/users: the users assigned to the site. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Error responses use api/error.json.
